title: WashU to host two polling places
summary_en: WashU will host two polling places on Election Day, Tuesday, Nov. 3. St. Louis County voters may cast their ballots at the Athletic Complex, while those registered to vote in St. Louis are invited to vote at the McDonnell Medical Sciences Building, 4565 McKinley Ave.
title_cn: WashU to host two polling places

title: WashU study helps Martian astronauts prepare for dust
summary_en: WashU assistant research professor Scott VanBommel is the lead author of a new paper that examines how dust interacts with Mars rover Perseverance’s spacesuit swatches and other materials.
title_cn: WashU study helps Martian astronauts prepare for dust

title: High-risk pregnancy care reaches families closer to home
summary_en: WashU Medicine maternal-fetal specialists are collaborating with rural obstetricians to reduce patients’ travel time and improve access to high-risk pregnancy care.
title_cn: High-risk pregnancy care reaches families closer to home
